Keep company facilities separate. Keep origin, exporting country and destination distinct.
Treat dates and policy changes carefully: a proposal is not effective law. Preserve
conflicts and historical/future measures. Unknown fields must be null.
Return ONLY the requested JSON object.  This is a quality audit of cached sources. Source-reported applicability is not independently verified law. Do not promote a national rule into company exposure.

Different products, origins, tariff programs, or dated stages are not automatically contradictory. The classification MUST agree with the reason. An old conditional expiry and a later renewal are compatible. Do not verify current law from memory. Explain the reason briefly for every pair.

The claims differ in scope (specific ruling vs. general heading) and program application (Section 301 specific vs. base tariff), making them non-contradictory.

conflict_c90eaebcfbc236fb1cb1b7ac.reason: Claim 1 states a 25% Section 301 tariff applies to China-origin PCBs, whereas Claim 2 asserts an additional 20% duty effective March 4, 2025. The claims present conflicting duty rates (25% vs. 20%) for the same product origin and category without clarifying if they are cumulative or alternative measures.
